name: Lucian
title: the Purifier

passive.name: Lightslinger

description.normalized: After using an Ability, Lucian's next Attack within 3.5 seconds will fire two shots. The second shot deals 35% / 50% / 65% physical damage, increased to 100% against minions. The second shot is a separate Attack that applies on-hit effects and can critical strike. Vigilance: When healed or shielded by allied champions, or when a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, Lucian's next two attacks deal an additional 20 (+10% AD) magic damage (stores up to four empowered attacks).

passive.rawParsedText:
After using an Ability, Lucian's next Attack within 3.5 seconds will fire two shots.

The second shot deals 35% / 50% / 65% physical damage, increased to 100% against minions. The second shot is a separate Attack that applies on-hit effects and can critical strike.

Vigilance: When healed or shielded by allied champions, or when a nearby enemy champion is immobilized, Lucian's next two attacks deal an additional 20 (+10% AD) magic damage (stores up to four empowered attacks).

q.name: Piercing Light

description.normalized: Shoots a bolt of piercing light through an enemy unit, damaging enemies in a line for 80 / 125 / 170 / 215 (+65% / 85% / 105% / 125% AD) physical damage.

q.rawParsedText: Shoots a bolt of piercing light through an enemy unit, damaging enemies in a line for 80 / 125 / 170 / 215 (+65% / 85% / 105% / 125% AD) physical damage.

w.name: Ardent Blaze

description.normalized: Fires a shot that explodes at the end of its range or on the first enemy hit, dealing 75 / 125 / 175 / 225 (+90% AP) magic damage, briefly revealing enemies and marking them for 6 seconds. When Lucian or an ally damages a marked enemy, Lucian gains 65 / 70 / 75 / 80 Movement Speed for 1 second. When allied champions trigger the mark, it grants Lucian Vigilance.

w.rawParsedText:

When Lucian or an ally damages a marked enemy, Lucian gains 65 / 70 / 75 / 80 Movement Speed for 1 second. When allied champions trigger the mark, it grants Lucian Vigilance.

e.name: Relentless Pursuit

description.normalized: Quickly dashes a short distance. Cooldown is reduced by 1 second whenever Lucian hits an enemy with Lightslinger ( 2 seconds for champions).

e.rawParsedText:
Quickly dashes a short distance.

Cooldown is reduced by 1 second whenever Lucian hits an enemy with Lightslinger ( 2 seconds for champions).

r.name: The Culling

description.normalized: Fires rapidly in a direction for 3 seconds. Each shot deals 20 / 35 / 50 (+25% AD +10% AP) physical damage to the first enemy hit. Fires a total of 22 / 26 / 30 bullets. Lucian may use Relentless Pursuit during The Culling.Recast to cancel early. Minions take 200% damage from The Culling.
